name: agentz
description: Agentz by Azure with Danidu: a central marketplace of reviewed agent plugins (skills, agents, commands) for Claude Code, VS Code, Copilot CLI and Cursor.

plugins.name: agentz-publisher
plugins.description: Guides contributors through publishing to the agentz marketplace in four phases: Analyse the idea, Research the catalog for duplicates, Build with HVE Core, and Validate with evals before opening a pull request.

plugins.name: bicep-avm-review
plugins.description: Reviews Bicep templates against Azure Verified Modules (AVM) and organisation conventions, and produces a traceable findings report.

plugins.name: onboarding
plugins.description: Sets up a machine for the agentz marketplace: adds it to every installed client, installs plugins, and prepares contributors

plugins.name: songwriting
plugins.description: Writes and revises original English song lyrics, with structured verses, memorable choruses, natural rhyme and singability feedback.
